description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error types, comparing “All Changes” to “All Errors”. The chart contains six slices representing different error categories: P, PW, RW, N, NW, and an unlabelled category. In the “All Changes” chart, the slices represent the following proportions: P at 5%, PW at 1%, RW at 14%, N at 50%, NW at 26%, and the unlabelled category at 4%. In the “All Errors” chart, the slices represent: P at 5%, PW at 1%, RW at 6%, N at 56%, NW at 29%, and the unlabelled category at 3%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is provided to identify the categories represented by the colors green, light green, yellow, light blue, purple, and light orange. The slices in both charts appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion, moving clockwise.
